text: For years, manifesting felt like something just out of my reach. One day I decided to try Sara Rivers arche type quiz, and it changed everything. My result matched exactly who I am, and only then did I understand how it really works. If you're struggling with it too, give it a chance. It only takes a few minutes. ❤️
Bonito, mas tem desafinação no som.
